top_signals.title: Nasdaq 100 Climbs to Its First Record Since June: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: A renewed rally in chipmakers drove the Nasdaq 100 to its first record since June, with sentiment also bolstered by a drop in oil prices amid hopes for diplomatic efforts to end the war in Iran.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Quantum Marketing Season 2 Trailer
top_signals.summary: From social media to AI, advertising has changed dramatically in a short time. Host Raja Rajamannar sits down with marketing leaders to learn how they cut through the noise to reach consumers. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Canada’s six largest banks explore tokenized Canadian dollar deposits
top_signals.summary: The country’s largest financial institutions are exploring tokenized deposits for interbank payments, just weeks after regulators clarified how they should be treated.
